items.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: But there’s two on the Sinatra and Jobim record, there’s one called “She’s So Sensitive” and “Canto Casual”

ctx.x: When you worked, you’ve been with a couple of different record labels. If you went to them and said we would like to do a CD of all original material, what would they respond?

We did try to do one, for one of the labels. And it wasn’t received well. And I think we were, the funny part was we were three songs off. We had a bunch of good songs and then there were a couple at the end of the list that weren’t so hot. And so we literally in like a day or two came up with three songs to replace those but the die was cast as it were. But it’s something that — I like sneaking them on the records as opposed to a whole record just for familiarity’s sake. But there’s two on the Sinatra and Jobim…

How is the technology of the day affecting selling your music? You made a crack about you had the “Stage & Screen” CD with you at the concert and you found a funny way to put it, you said, “Yeah if you buy the CD next time I come back I’ll sell you a CD player.”
